snippets.title: SSO and MFA Controls
snippets.text: The platform supports SAML 2.0 and OIDC single sign-on, enforced MFA through the customer's identity provider, and role-based access controls for presales and response teams.

snippets.title: Encryption and Key Management
snippets.text: Customer content is encrypted in transit with TLS and at rest with AES-256. Key management, rotation, and access are reviewed through the security policy before final submission.

snippets.title: SOC 2 Evidence Pack
snippets.text: We provide SOC 2 Type II evidence under NDA, including control summaries, audit period information, and security questionnaire support from the compliance owner.

snippets.title: Incident Response Commitments
snippets.text: Security incidents follow a documented triage, escalation, notification, and post-incident review process. Customer-specific notification terms require legal and security approval.

snippets.title: Enterprise Implementation Plan
snippets.text: Implementation is delivered through discovery, workspace configuration, source-document ingestion, validation workshops, and a controlled rollout with named customer and vendor owners.

snippets.title: Pricing Assumptions
snippets.text: Pricing is scoped by user tier, implementation services, and support expectations. Any volume discounts, public-sector terms, or payment-processing constraints require commercial approval.
